verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a way to version, review (approve), or roll back automations, such as scheduled rollouts or CLI/CI-driven config changes. What it does show is adjacent: an emergency kill switch, CLI/Console API CRUD usable in CI/CD (a user-side route to git-based versioning), and prompt versioning for AI Configs, which covers prompts rather than automations. None of these is the product's own version history, review, or rollback capability for automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
